assumptions.choice: Close the position when the daily closing price is greater than or equal to the stored take-profit target.
assumptions.reason: The specification defines a daily OHLCV feed and does not specify an intrabar or limit-order execution method for target reaches.

assumptions.choice: Use the completed buy order's executed price as Entry and ATR(14) available on that execution bar for the target calculation.
assumptions.reason: This is the closest literal interpretation of Entry and ATR at the time of entry under Backtrader's next-bar order execution.
